$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFKR (AIP France, chart dated 2026-08-06): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Saint-Rémy-de-Maurienne

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: AD suitable for aircraft whose pilots: have been assessed as competent to use the aerodrome by an instructor holding a mountain rating following a site reconnaissance or; hold a mountain qualification.
AD suitable for HEL and microlights.
Microlight pilots are strongly advised to have completed the mountain training course organised by the FFPLUM.
Commercial air travel by aeroplane is prohibited, with the exception of sightseeing flights.
Usable declared distances: TORA and TODA RWY 16 and 34 reduced due to obstacles in TKOF funnels.
Paragliding area South-East of the AD.
Tricky flying conditions in Southerly winds.
Presence of extra-high-voltage power lines beneath the flight paths of ARR and DEP.
Departure and arrival following the valley.
Landing on RWY 16 and 34: do not descend below 1800 ft AMSL at the base leg due to a high-voltage power line within the AD's easements, running parallel to the runway and unmarked.
Flying over the Arkéma factory in La Chambre is prohibited.
Take-off from RWY 34: Turn right heading 016°.
Do not turn before1525 ft AMSL.
